findings.suggested_change: Either party may terminate this AGREEMENT without cause upon providing 30 days prior written notice to the other party.

findings.explanation: Payment is due 45 days after the end of each quarter, which exceeds standard 30-day payment terms and delays your cash flow.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I hope you are well. Thank you for sharing the agreement. Before we sign, I would like to suggest one adjustment: - In the relevant clause, payment is due 45 days after the end of each quarter, which delays cash flow. I propose changing this to: The REVENUE SHARE FEE shall be payable quarterly in arrears 30 days after the end of each quarter for the duration of this AGREEMENT. Thank you for your time and understanding. Best regards,
